doc_friction.issue: 'Pick the project that has gone longest without a new piece' was a tie this run: Hearth & Horizon had three pieces and Saints by Candlelight one on 2026-11-12. The shallow clone hid the history until git fetch --deepen=200; the prompt could tell runs to deepen before the git log.
The map lists prompt.md at 134 lines against a budget of 100, land-your-work.md at 163 against 160 and cloud-session.md at 96 against 80; all over budget.

deviations.why: Did not run the full run_workflow_locally --for-changes set (149 steps in 12 workflows) for a text-and-page change.
deviations.did: Ran the venture's own checks (check-script and node --test, 14 of 14) and let PR CI run the rest.

notes: Creative track. Project: Saints by Candlelight. Piece: episode 101, slug methodios-and-theodora-and-the-sunday-of-the-icons, 7,613 words, text only because the audio folders are at 423 MB (cap 400). It closes the icon arc of episodes 99 and 100 and follows the PRODUCTION.md next-up suggestion. The adversarial re-read removed Methodios's burial place (not confidently sourced) and the named saints in the first Synodikon reading; it also corrected Theodore's place of death to a headland and the date of the first Hagia Sophia mosaics to about twenty years after 843. No agent doc: nothing a later run needs beyond PRODUCTION.md, which this PR updates.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a skilled writer drafting and fact-checking a 7,600-word sourced bedtime script

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
